title: Audit Trail Event
description: Schema for append-only, tamper-evident audit trail events. Events are hash-linked in a causal chain. Token usage fields are OPTIONAL — events without them are excluded from efficiency projections per ADR-053.

event_id.description: UUIDv7 providing temporal ordering and stable identity for lineage.

event_type.description: Type of audit event. Determines which optional fields are applicable.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor (agent, service, or human) that caused this event.

causal_ref.description: Hash or ID of the previous event in the chain, enabling tamper-evidence verification.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for the event.

token_usage.description: Optional token usage data for efficiency projection per ADR-053. Events without this field are excluded from EFFICIENCY_PROJECTION computations.

input_tokens.description: Number of tokens sent to the provider (prompt + context).

output_tokens.description: Number of tokens received from the provider (completion).

context_window_size.description: Maximum context window size for the provider/model used.

utilization_percent.description: Percentage of context window utilized. >100 indicates overflow attempt.

overflow_flag.description: True if utilization exceeded safe threshold (default 80% per OD-T5-002-B).

model_id.description: Model identifier for per-model granularity (V3 deferred per OD-T5-002-A).

routing_type.description: Determinism routing type per ADR-029. Used for service_ratio calculation.

context_composition.description: Optional breakdown of context composition for efficiency analysis.

items.description: Hash references to project intelligence documents consumed.
Hash references to governance documents consumed.

redundant_bytes_estimate.description: Estimated bytes of redundant context that could be optimized.

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of event payload for integrity verification.

then.description: PROVIDER_CALL events MUST include token_usage for efficiency tracking.
Attempt lifecycle events MUST reference task and attempt IDs.
